name: Strakka ThermaLine Insulated Chrome Jogger
description: Tapered jogger-cut pants in charcoal fleece-lined nylon with thermal baffling along the outer leg — designed to manage heat dissipation from chrome legs that run warm without overheating the fabric or the wearer. Elastic cuffs have a magnetic-break snap for quick removal over chrome feet. Two side zip pockets, slim profile. A casual pant that solves a real thermal management problem.
functionality: Thermal baffling panels channel heat away from hot-running chrome limbs. Magnetic-break cuffs allow quick removal over aug feet without removing footwear.
what_it_says: You've optimized around your augmentation without making it your whole personality.
worn_by: aug users with high-output chrome legs
people who run hot and need managed thermals
story_hooks: The thermal baffling is so effective it masks the heat signature of the chrome inside — useful if someone's trying to avoid thermal scanning.
A cheaper knockoff version lacks the baffling and scorches at the thigh panel after two weeks of use with high-output chrome.
